nodes.name: schemas.py
nodes.summary: Central Pydantic request-validation schema module defining Create/Update payload models for every mutable USDM entity in the application (activities, elements, visits, timings, arms, epochs, amendments, and more), including ISO 8601 duration and timing-window consistency validators.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses Pydantic v2 field_validator/model_validator decorators (_validate_iso8601_duration, _validate_window_all_or_none) shared across TimingCreate/TimingUpdate, and per-class validators for conditional 'other reason' text fields.

nodes.name: _validate_iso8601_duration
nodes.summary: Validator helper that checks a string matches ISO 8601 duration syntax (e.g. P1D, P2W).

nodes.name: _validate_window_all_or_none
nodes.summary: Validator helper enforcing that timing window_lower, window_upper, and window_label are either all specified or all absent together.
